CustomField.formula: IF( ISBLANK(Due_Date__c), "⚪ No Due Date", IF( Due_Date__c < TODAY(), "🔴 Overdue by " & TEXT(ABS(Due_Date__c - TODAY())) & " days", IF( Due_Date__c = TODAY(), "🔴 Due today", IF( Due_Date__c - TODAY() <= 14, "🟠 " & TEXT(Due_Date__c - TODAY()) & " days remaining", "🟢 " & TEXT(Due_Date__c - TODAY()) & " days remaining" ) ) ) )
CustomField.label: Days Until Due
